#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed 7 Days to Die server — generated by provision().
# Settings: <ROOT>/installs/sdtd/gamedash-servers/test/serverconfig.xml
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
# keep the join + admin-console passwords in step with the ones set in GameDash
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/sdtd/gamedash-servers/test/serverconfig.xml" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
from xml.sax.saxutils import quoteattr
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
for name, val in (("ServerPassword", join), ("TelnetPassword", admin)):
    t = re.sub(r'(<property\s+name="%s"\s+value=)"[^"]*"' % name, lambda m: m.group(1) + quoteattr(val), t)
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(t)
SYNC
cd "<ROOT>/installs/sdtd" || exit 1
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.
exec ./7DaysToDieServer.x86_64 -logfile "<ROOT>/installs/sdtd/gamedash-servers/test/server.log" -quit -batchmode -nographics -dedicated -configfile="<ROOT>/installs/sdtd/gamedash-servers/test/serverconfig.xml"
files.installs/sdtd/gamedash-test-stop.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed graceful stop: ask the server (over its local console) to save and shut down.
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - 8081 "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'STOP'
import socket, sys, time
try:
    s = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", int(sys.argv[1])), timeout=5)
    time.sleep(0.5); s.sendall((sys.argv[2] + "\r\n").encode()); time.sleep(0.5)
    s.sendall(b"shutdown\r\n"); time.sleep(1); s.close()
except OSError:
    pass
STOP
i=0
while [ $i -lt 60 ] && pgrep -f -- '-configfile=<ROOT>/installs/sdtd/gamedash-servers/test/serverconfig.xml' >/dev/null; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
exit 0
